# AI_Assisted_Energy_Management

**Domain**: Cross

## Definition
The use of artificial intelligence algorithms to dynamically optimize power distribution and consumption across robotic systems in real-time. Provides a framework for adaptive energy control that can be mapped to TCC's topology-aware scheduling to reduce power hotspots in manycore systems.
